_comment: #675 ledger: the eslint-plugin-react-hooks 7 violations that existed when the gate was turned on, per file per rule. eslint.config.mjs holds these three rules at `warn` until #584 burns them to zero; this file is what keeps that interval safe. Counts are per rule so a net-zero swap inside one file cannot pass (#624). A row the tree no longer contains FAILS as stale rather than silently pre-authorising the next violation on that file (#631). Shrink freely — a lower count is reported, never failed. Adding a row to silence a NEW violation defeats the gate. When this empties, delete it and the three "warn" lines in eslint.config.mjs.
